title: Scotch & Soda Collaborates With Royal Delft on Heritage-inspired Collection
text:
The Scotch & Soda and Royal Delft collection brings together contemporary fashion and centuries-old Dutch craftsmanship.
, the Amsterdam-based fashion brand, is teaming up with Dutch design brand Royal Delft for a women’s and men’s collection. Royal Delft is known for its hand-painted Delft Blue ceramics.
The men’s and women’s ready-to-wear collection features prints, jacquards and embroidery developed in partnership with Royal Delft. Thedesign team delved into Royal Delft’s archives, using traditional motifs, patterns and techniques. The references were reinterpreted into prints and design elements that reflect heritage and innovation. The 24-piece collection features an assortment of men’s and women’s rtw, including allover printed separates, embroidered T-shirts and sweatshirts, along with laser-printed denim.
The collection is available at scotchandsoda.com in the EU and U.S. and select retailers with prices ranging from $48 to $268.
“At the heart of Scotch & Soda is a commitment to creativity, artistic expression and a celebration of the city of Amsterdam. This collaboration brought those guiding principles together in a unique way. Scotch & Soda x Royal Delft honors traditional Dutch craftsmanship and reimagines the iconic Delft Blue print in a new contemporary style, pushing boundaries as only Scotch & Soda can,” said Tony Lucia, president of the EU Division of Scotch & Soda.
Bluestar Alliance, whose portfolio includes Scotch & Soda, Off-White, Palm Angels, Dickies, Hurley, Justice, Bebe, Tahari, Limited Too and Brookstone, among other brands, acquired Scotch & Soda’s U.S.-based assets in 2023. Founded in 2006 by Joseph Gabbay and Ralph Gindi, Bluestar’s portfolio of fashion and lifestyle brands generates more than $14 billion in global retail sales. Since the 17th century, Royal Delft has been creating a world of high-quality Delft Blue hand-painted objects and decorations.
Their products are available in the flagship and brand store in Delft, and at national and international retailers, and online.
